title: Dynamic eGFR model with machine learning predicts kidney graft outcomes
summary: A method combining a dynamic model of glomerular filtration rate with machine learning and parameter uncertainty was trained on 892 kidney transplant recipients and validated in an independent cohort of 847. It predicted graft function over time and identified an eGFR threshold for classifying high-risk patients. Graft outcome accuracy was 0.88 +/- 0.04 (F1 0.81 +/- 0.06) for the first postoperative year and 0.85 +/- 0.05 (F1 0.79 +/- 0.07) for the second. The abstract does not name the machine-learning algorithm; the evaluation is retrospective and not a clinical-use test.
